description: Java class 'SimpleMapProcess' that manages a sequence of string operations for a specific field, including reading operation configurations from XML and executing them.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcess
classes.description: Handles a list of string operations for a specific field, reading operation configurations from XML and executing them.

methods.name: SimpleMapProcess
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the process with an XML element, extracting the field attribute and reading operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes all stored string operations on the input map, producing results, messages, and considering locale and class loader.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field associated with this process.

methods.name: readOperations
methods.description: Reads and initializes string operations from the provided XML element.
